body.condition: The graph feasibility margin satisfies \(\delta_{\mathrm{feas}}(\mathcal O_{G_{\mathrm{obs}}})\ge\kappa_G>0\).

novel.justification: This condition separates every excluded order in the combined residual-and-completion score. In particular it excludes incompatible orders lying exactly on a positive-definite-completion boundary; it is a stability premise, not an identifying restriction used to define compatibility.
